title: The hitting time for loose Hamilton cycles in r-graphs
summary: A Lean formalisation of a hitting time theorem of Wanfang Chen, Jared León and Xizhi Liu. For every fixed integer r ≥ 3, assume all r-element subsets of n vertices are exposed in a uniformly random order. As n tends to infinity through multiples of r − 1, with probability tending to one, a loose Hamilton cycle first emerges exactly when the last isolated vertex disappears.
